spec: pocket SPEC v3, task D2 (Seixo, variant B)
frame: SPEC: x right from the case's leftmost point, y towards the player, mm (= KiCad top view)

mounting_holes.note: M2 from below through the bottom plate's pillar, nut on top of the board
M2 from below through the bottom plate's pillar, nut on top of the board

levels_note: h = height above the board's top face; each polygon is free room at that height (the case, its fixed parts, the speaker box, the battery bay, the panel and controls boards taken out)

stack.kind: LOW (PECAS stack.low): Teensy soldered straight on the Audio Board with long headers
stack.usb_end: left (x small): the Teensy's micro-B faces the left wall

usb_plug.note: 90 deg micro-B overmould 11 x 11 x 7.5 (PECAS micro_b_link); its cable goes up/back to the panel board

controls.encoder_rot: as the eTuttino (A/B/C to the back)

connector.note: 10-way SH header on top, 12 along y, cable leaves +x then drops in cables.controls

pot.note: horizontal-type 9 mm switched pot on a VERTICAL board right of the shaft (x 21.62-23.22), its body to the left, M7 bushing nutted on the lid; the pot board meets the controls board's left edge at 90 deg

panel.note: board top at z 23.9: it passes 0.45 over the Teensy's micro-B plug, so NO parts on its underside; front edge on the flat boss of the wall, M2 screws from below into posts from the lid

battery.board_notch: the outline leaves out x < 68.95, y > 45.85 and, for the connector pocket, x < 24.00, y > 39.10

connector_pocket.note: the battery's JST PH plug mates here with a short pigtail from the main board (12.3 x 6.75 x 7.6 of room): pull the battery out of the hatch and unplug, without opening the lid

pigtail_way_in.note: through the pocket's back wall and roof, from J_BAT (or pads) in connector_zones.back_left

wire_hole.note: sealed with glue after threading the 2 wires

controls.note: the 10-way SH cable drops here from the controls board to J_CTL

cables.panel: micro-B cable (~40) from the panel board's back edge to the Teensy's plug; SH-8 (~100) to J_PNL
cables.battery: 3 wires (~60) from the bay's wire exit to J_BAT
cables.speaker: 2 wires (152) from the box's wire hole to J_SPK

back_left.note: under the panel board (nothing on its underside), left of the Teensy's plug: PH plugs (10.5 tall) and the SH-8 fit; check the exact edge against levels['10.5']

J_CTL.note: SH-10 vertical (4.25 + plug) between the Audio Board's front edge and the battery notch
